semantics.action: candidate factor, one of three reference factors, or their equal-weight blend at close t
semantics.executionRisk: every selected sleeve is rechecked after drift; risk compliance bypasses the no-trade band with minimum proportional scale-down
semantics.factorOpportunity: all fixed sleeves evaluated for one next bar from the selected policy path's exact shared pretrade book; the ex-post oracle is an audit upper bound only
semantics.incrementalAttribution: independent full-path RL minus validation-selected mechanical baseline; gross edge minus incremental cost reconciles net active return
semantics.learningConfiguration: episodes, learning rate, discount, and exploration were frozen by a reference-fixture outer-train-only blocked stability audit before Study validation; validation and test do not tune them
semantics.objective: mean validation net Sharpe across every successful seed/fold
semantics.policyRationale: exact linear chosen-versus-runner-up Q-margin decomposition; Q scores are uncalibrated and contextual
semantics.researchHorizonRole: fixed question identity and disclosure; one-step RL rewards are not direct multi-bar forecasts
semantics.reward: net return after 10bps cost minus 0.10 * gross_return^2
semantics.state: fixed causal scalars known through close t
semantics.testRole: reported audit evidence; never enters promotion
semantics.testVisibilityWarning: Repeated candidate changes after inspecting test metrics consume their holdout value; use a new external holdout for production claims.
